With Halloween right around the corner, how about we put together a list of horror games so people got something to play during the spooky time? Here's my personal list of horror or other otherwise creepy games I've riled up over the years:

DreadOut (FatalFrame clone for PC, set in Indonesia rather than in Japan. Rather short and lacks polish, but that's not surprising seeing how it's the first title of the developers).

Dead Space 1 (when Isaac would still keep his mouth shout apart from the occasional groans of pain).

Stalker series (not primarily a horror game, but can make you shit bricks like you wouldn't believe)

System Shock I / II (GoG recently brought out an updated version of the first title, and SS II should run without problems).

Amongst the Sleep (Very atmospheric game about how a scared toddler perceives the world, but extremely short, clocks in at around 2 hours)

**Outlast ** (Muh jumpscares, muh batteries)

Penumbra series (the older brother of Amnesia. Play Overture and Black Plague, ignore Requiem)

Scratches (Very, very oldschool point n click adventure. Gameplay often is confusing, but dear god, they got the atmosphere right)

Miasmata (You're dying from a terrible disease, are stuck on an island, and some thing wants to eat you. Survival horror with the emphasis on survival )

The Void ( Not really a horror game, but can be pretty disturbing and/or surreal. Very artsy though, so it's not for everyone)

Cry of Fear (Originally a gold source mod, now a free standalone game. Basically Silent Hill in Sweden, just with less Somalian immigrants)

Grey ( Survival horror source mod. Another Silent Hill lookalike. ).

House of Horrors ( FPS source mod. Fairly well known).

Spookie's House of Jump Scares (Exactly what is says on the tin)

Sanitarium (Old-school point n click horror adventure. Rather surreal at times)

Silent Hill series (I don't need to explain this, do I?)

Clive Barker's Undying ( Doesn't have much horror in it by modern standards, but still a pretty good FPS)

RPG Maker Horror Games (Ib, The Witch's House, The Crooked Man / The Boogieman / The Sandman)

Mind you that all of these are PC Games, so I've you got good console horror titles (or other good horror games in general), fire away

Resident Evil (The original, I haven't played much of any beyond that.) The HD version from the Gamecube (that's now on PC) scared the hell out of me as a kid and is a really great horror game. If that scares you too much, the PSX/DS version isn't nearly as scary due to limited graphics.

Eldritch is another good game. I wouldn't explicitly say it's "horror" but it gets really tense when being chased by the horrors within (especially the lizard statues and Shogoths.) On the surface, it seems like the devs were just checking off boxes of what's popular (Minecrafts style graphics, Lovecraftian horror, Rogue elements) but the game is definitely worth playing.

SCP Containment Breach is another one (and also free.) Based on the SCP web fiction, it is a really tense game about trying to survive and escape when a lot of powerful and dangerous creatures and devices escape containment. Has an odd blink mechanic, since many SCPs are activate by looking at or away from them, but it works really well. Finally, random generation can make it frustrating at times when you can't find what you need, but keeps it fresh as you play it over and over since you'll come across different SCPs and items.

Fair disclosure, I haven't played Eldritch or SCP myself yet, only watched streamers play them. Waiting on a deal on Eldritch and just haven't got around to SCP yet, but feel confident enough to recommend them all the same.

Finally, GOG is having a Halloween sale that just started that includes a bunch of horror games, plus the Witcher and Postal series. It includes a few of the games that OP mentioned, so is worth looking at (I wouldn't be surprised to see a Steam Halloween sale before the weekend is over either, if what you're looking for isn't on GOG's or if you prefer Steam.)
